description: Initializes the consensus process for a new ledger by gathering the previous ledger, updating the trusted validator set, and starting the consensus round with the current trusted and untrusted validators.
Begins a new consensus round by passing the previous ledger, trusted/untrusted validator sets, and other parameters to the consensus engine.
Sets up the internal state for a new consensus round, including the previous ledger, current trusted/untrusted nodes, and whether the node is proposing.
Determines if the node should validate in this round based on validator keys, ledger sequence, and network state; prepares for the round.
Advances the consensus process by handling time-based events, such as proposal timeouts and round progression.
Handles periodic consensus state updates, including proposal collection, dispute resolution, and checking for consensus progress or timeouts.
Processes incoming proposals from peers, updating the set of peer positions and triggering dispute creation if necessary.
Updates the local node's proposal based on peer input, transaction disputes, and consensus parameters.
Compares the local transaction set with those from peers to identify and track disputed transactions for consensus voting.
Evaluates whether consensus has been reached based on proposer counts, agreement levels, timing, and consensus thresholds.
Finalizes the consensus round, builds the new ledger, applies transactions, and triggers validation and ledger publication.
Builds the new last closed ledger from the consensus transaction set, applies any remaining transactions, and manages validation and ledger state updates.
Records the built ledger in history, checks for ledger acceptance, and coordinates further ledger processing.
Stores the newly built ledger and its consensus hash in the ledger history cache for future retrieval and validation.
Manages the voting process for the Negative UNL by scoring validator reliability, selecting candidates for disabling or re-enabling, and constructing transactions to modify the Negative UNL.
Builds a table of validator reliability scores over a configurable interval using validation history.
Identifies which validators are candidates for disabling (adding to Negative UNL) or re-enabling (removing from Negative UNL) based on their scores and protocol thresholds.
Deterministically selects a candidate from the list of possible validators to disable or re-enable.
Constructs and adds a ttUNL_MODIFY transaction to the ledger's transaction set to enact a Negative UNL change.
Validates and applies a ttUNL_MODIFY transaction, updating the Negative UNL in the ledger if all protocol rules are satisfied.
